progressDefinition: All alive deployed German units: mean and minimum distance to closest public capital; fixed initial group members recorded on each group's creation and tracked through removal and phase end; deaths counted separately, group end survivor mean is not interpreted without per-member/death records.

This is a descriptive waiting/congestion proxy, not a reachability or legal-move test.

rngLimitation: After action divergence, equal initial seeds do not align battle dice; no per-battle causal attribution.
decisionRule: Two development games decide research value only, never production adoption or overall strength. Stop on anomaly or opponent identity mismatch; no retuning/retry. If gains disagree across games or all-army mean/minimum distance regresses versus 014, retain 014. Even consistent gains only retain a promising research candidate; report losses, rejections, cap, and fixed-cohort trajectories.
